commands.stdout:
usage: run_v23_diagnostic.py [-h] --wasm-sha256 WASM_SHA256 --fixture FIXTURE
                             [--fixture-name FIXTURE_NAME] --output OUTPUT
                             [--browser {chrome,firefox,both}]
                             [--arm {smoke,proof,hang,js-thread,all,wd}]
                             [--case-id CASE_ID] [--rounds {1,3,5}]

Run the predeclared bounded v23 no-host cohort only after an actual owner
link. No make, host, service changes, frozen-profile writes or live documents.
The temporary HTTP server/browser are owned subprocesses, closed on every
exit.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --wasm-sha256 WASM_SHA256
                        explicit actual owner-linked candidate pin
  --fixture FIXTURE
  --fixture-name FIXTURE_NAME
                        actual loader filename; defaults to fixture basename
  --output OUTPUT       new directory, never overwritten
  --browser {chrome,firefox,both}
  --arm {smoke,proof,hang,js-thread,all,wd}
  --case-id CASE_ID     W-D module case id; not part of bounded diagnostic
                        cohort
  --rounds {1,3,5}      bounded cohort requires 3; W-D requires 5; 1 is
                        preparation only

commands.argv_description: Import test_v23_wd_reader from wasm_sdk_probe/tests, create a fresh synthetic page for each mutation, then call wd.judge(page, case, expected, oracle).
Repeat wrong-click with the test's xTwips/yTwips field names, to distinguish an ignored-field mutation from the test's actual mutation.

interpretation: The requested payload x/y=999999 mutation was accepted as PASS. The existing unit control mutates xTwips/yTwips and is rejected as FAIL. The x/y fields are ignored by this synthetic protocol payload, so the requested four-control condition is not met. No source or criteria changes were made.
